rationale: C22 plausibly supplied the principal administrative and drafting template: appointment of a Special Assistant to the President, assignment of enumerated long-range facilities-planning responsibilities, authority to obtain assistance from relevant departments and agencies, and an expectation of recommendations to the President. The child adapts that machinery from public works generally to aviation facilities. C05 and C09 provide strong subject-matter parallels involving comprehensive transportation or airport studies, but neither matches the child's appointment structure and interagency authority as closely as C22.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am delighted that you have agreed to serve as Special Assistant to the President for aviation facilities planning. In this capacity you will be responsible for: 1. The direction and coordination of a long-range study... 2. The development of a comprehensive plan... 3. The formulation of legislative, organizational, administrative and budgetary recommendations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby appoint you as Special Assistant to the President to serve as coordinator of public works planning. In the performance of these duties, one of your responsibilities will be to keep me informed with regard to... The current long-range plans and programs...
shared_material.explanation: Both letters appoint a Special Assistant to coordinate long-range planning for nationally important physical facilities and specify the assignment through an enumerated list.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you are authorized to call upon not only these two Departments, but upon any official of the Executive Branch for assistance
shared_material.parent_excerpt: you are authorized to call upon the Secretaries of Defense; Interior; Agriculture; Commerce; Health, Education, and Welfare... and other departments and agencies... to assist you in the coordination of long-range plans and programs
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts C22's concrete interagency-assistance authority to the narrower aviation assignment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I shall expect that from time to time you will give me reports of your progress and that you will promptly advise me of anything that I might do to expedite your work.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As this activity progresses, you are requested to make recommendations to me for its further strengthening and improvement.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by establishing a continuing reporting and recommendation relationship between the appointed Special Assistant and the President.
